Featuring distinct colorsone in rich aqua blue and the other in classic clear each piece is crafted with embossed Hemingray lettering, offering authentic style and historical character. The sturdy dome/cylindrical shapes make them striking display items or unique accents for creative projects. Both insulators are made from glass and retain their original, rugged look, suited for collectors or those appreciating vintage utility pieces. The aqua blue insulator especially stands out as a vibrant collectible, while the clear version brings classic appeal. Display them together as a conversation starter or separate for individual accents either way, their nostalgic charm is sure to enhance your space. Both items appear in good visible condition with no major cracks or chips noted. Perfect for industrial-style displays, utility collectors, or functional upcycling.

A.T. Cross & Manuscript
Gold Tone Writing Set and Calligraphy Fountain Pen
Gold-filled and Anodized Metal
7" x 3" x 1" (Case)

This lot includes a vintage A.T. Cross gold-filled pen and mechanical pencil set alongside a contemporary Manuscript calligraphy fountain pen. The Cross set features the brand's iconic engine-turned pinstripe finish and black conical tops, housed in a velvet-lined presentation case. The Manuscript pen offers a modern contrast with a vibrant lime green matte finish and a knurled grip designed for precise calligraphy work. Both sets represent quality craftsmanship in writing instrument design.
Cross set features 10K gold-filled barrels with hallmark branding on clips
Manuscript pen includes a textured knurled grip and original metal tin
Collection includes two distinct writing styles for various applications
Condition:
Good pre-owned condition. Cross instruments show light surface swirling and minor marks consistent with age and use. Manuscript pen has minor ink residue on the nib. Cases show light storage wear to the exterior.
Thank you for all of your support!
